shelves.name: Recreation. Leisure
shelves.scope: Recreation and leisure: sports, games, dance, outdoor recreation and amusements.
shelves.reason: OpenAlex has no subfield named for recreation, sports and games. Its topics on them (for example Sociology, History and Politics of Sport; Recreation, Leisure, Wilderness Management; Digital Games and Media; Diversity and Impact of Dance) are scattered over many subfields, among them Sociology and Political Science, Education, Orthopedics and Sports Medicine and Tourism, Leisure and Hospitality Management.

shelves.name: Handicrafts. Arts and crafts
shelves.scope: Handicrafts and the arts and crafts: making things by hand.
shelves.reason: OpenAlex has no subfield named for handicrafts. One topic, Crafts, Textile, and Design, sits under Museology.

shelves.name: Home economics
shelves.scope: Home economics: cooking, nutrition, household management and homemaking.
shelves.reason: OpenAlex has no subfield named for home economics. Its nearest topic, Culinary Culture and Tourism, sits under Tourism, Leisure and Hospitality Management, and Food Science covers part of the subject.

shelves.name: Photography
shelves.scope: Photography: the making of photographs and the processes and equipment it uses.
shelves.reason: OpenAlex has no subfield named for photography. Two topics touch it: Photographic and Visual Arts (under Museology) and Photography and Visual Culture (under History).

shelves.name: Hunting sports
shelves.scope: Hunting as a sport: methods, equipment and the pursuit of game animals.
shelves.reason: OpenAlex has no subfield and no topic named for hunting; the nearest topic, Rangeland and Wildlife Management, sits under Ecology.

shelves.name: Military science (General)
shelves.scope: Military science in general: the organization, strategy and conduct of armed forces.
shelves.reason: OpenAlex has no subfield named for military science. About a dozen topics on military subjects (for example Military History and Strategy; Military Defense Systems Analysis) are scattered under Political Science and International Relations, Aerospace Engineering, History and others.

shelves.name: Military engineering. Air forces
shelves.scope: Military engineering and air forces: fortification, field engineering and military aviation.
shelves.reason: OpenAlex has no subfield named for military engineering or air forces; Aerospace Engineering has topics on military technology (for example Military Technology and Strategies).

shelves.name: Maintenance and transportation
shelves.scope: Maintenance and transportation of armed forces: supply, logistics and military transport.
shelves.reason: OpenAlex has no subfield and no topic named for military logistics; the nearest topics are on military strategy and on maritime ports and logistics.

shelves.name: Naval science (General)
shelves.scope: Naval science in general: the organization and conduct of navies.
shelves.reason: OpenAlex has no subfield and no topic named for naval science; Maritime Security and History (under Political Science and International Relations) is the nearest topic.

shelves.name: Navigation. Merchant marine
shelves.scope: Navigation and the merchant marine: finding and keeping a course at sea, and commercial shipping.
shelves.reason: OpenAlex has no subfield named for navigation at sea or the merchant marine; topics cover parts of it: Maritime Navigation and Safety (under Ocean Engineering), Maritime Ports and Logistics and Maritime Transport Emissions and Efficiency.

shelves.name: Decorative arts
shelves.scope: Decorative arts: ceramics, glass, furniture, metalwork, textiles and ornament.
shelves.reason: OpenAlex has no subfield named for decorative arts; the topic names that mention ceramics are about technical ceramic materials, and the nearest subfield, Visual Arts and Performing Arts, is coarse.

shelves.name: Drawing. Design. Illustration
shelves.scope: Drawing, design and illustration: the technique and practice of drawing and graphic design.
shelves.reason: OpenAlex has no subfield named for drawing, design and illustration; one topic, Graphic Design and Typography, sits under the coarse subfield Visual Arts and Performing Arts.

shelves.name: Folklore
shelves.scope: Folklore: traditional tales, beliefs, customs and oral traditions.
shelves.reason: OpenAlex has no subfield named for folklore; one topic, Folklore, Mythology, and Literature Studies, sits under Literature and Literary Theory, and Cultural Studies and Anthropology cover related ground.

shelves.name: Manufactures
shelves.scope: Manufactures: the making of goods, including textiles, clothing, leather, wood and metal products.
shelves.reason: Partly covered: OpenAlex has no subfield named for the trades of textiles, clothing, leather and wood; four topics touch textiles (for example Fashion and Cultural Textiles; Textile materials and evaluations), and Industrial and Manufacturing Engineering covers manufacturing in general.

shelves.name: Aquaculture. Fisheries. Angling
shelves.scope: Aquaculture, fisheries and angling: raising and catching fish and other aquatic animals.
shelves.reason: Partly covered: OpenAlex has topics on fisheries and aquaculture (for example Marine and fisheries research; Aquaculture Nutrition and Growth, under Aquatic Science) but none named for angling or recreational fishing.

shelves.name: Naval architecture. Shipbuilding. Marine engineering
shelves.scope: Naval architecture, shipbuilding and marine engineering: the design and construction of ships and their machinery.
shelves.reason: OpenAlex has no subfield and no topic named for naval architecture or shipbuilding; Ocean Engineering is the nearest subfield.

shelves.name: Print media
shelves.scope: Print media: the print-making arts such as engraving, etching, woodcut and lithography.
shelves.reason: OpenAlex has no subfield or topic named for print-making as an art; its one name match, Nanofabrication and Lithography Techniques, is a technical process, and the nearest subfield, Visual Arts and Performing Arts, is coarse.

shelves.name: Social pathology. Social and public welfare. Criminology
shelves.scope: Social pathology, social and public welfare and criminology: crime, punishment, poverty and relief.
shelves.reason: Partly covered: OpenAlex has topics on criminal justice and poverty (for example Criminal Justice and Penology, under Law; Income, Poverty, and Inequality, under Sociology and Political Science) but no subfield named for social pathology and welfare.
